_readme: Rigmor Guardian rules. FormIDs are written XXXXXX:Plugin.esp (6 hex digits without the load-order byte, then the plugin that defines the record). settings.act = false only writes what would be done to RigmorGuardian.log; set it to true once the log shows the rules firing at the right moments.
